prompt: Diagnose this Sendable error with the module language mode and default isolation settings.

obligations.assertion: Respect authorized scope, preserve unrelated edits, and perform no unauthorized external action.
Do not invent execution, performance, manual accessibility, physical-device or client-invocation evidence.
Apply the identified workflow within its invocation contract.
Read the module's language mode, strict-concurrency level, default isolation and upcoming features before diagnosing.
Explain the diagnostic in terms of the boundary crossed and the value's ownership.
Do not add unchecked Sendable, detached work or blanket MainActor.run removal as a shortcut.
